description: Curated SecHub Resources SC4S pack for Cisco Duo Admin API authentication, activity, telephony, Trust Monitor, selected user/phone inventory, and selected integration/application inventory JSON records relayed as one JSON object per line.

event_families.label: Duo Trust Monitor anomalous authentication security event

normalized_fields.event_type: Duo event type such as authentication or activity
normalized_fields.vendor_raw_action: Raw Duo result/action before any analyst normalization
normalized_fields.action_name: Duo activity action name; preserves nested Activity Logs v2 action.name where present
normalized_fields.outcome_result: Duo Activity Logs v2 outcome result where present
normalized_fields.target_type: Duo Activity Logs v2 target object type where present
normalized_fields.telephony_id: Duo Telephony Logs v2 event identifier
normalized_fields.txid: Duo transaction identifier for auth/telephony correlation
normalized_fields.context: Duo telephony context such as enrollment or authentication
normalized_fields.type: Duo telephony delivery type such as sms or phone
normalized_fields.credits: Telephony credit count reported by Duo
normalized_fields.phone: Masked phone number from Duo Telephony Logs v2 examples
normalized_fields.surfaced_timestamp: Duo Trust Monitor surfaced time in Unix epoch milliseconds
normalized_fields.state: Duo Trust Monitor workflow state such as new or processed
normalized_fields.trust_explanation_type: First Trust Monitor explanation type helper derived from explanations array
normalized_fields.trust_explanation: First Trust Monitor explanation summary helper derived from explanations array
normalized_fields.priority_reason_type: First Trust Monitor priority reason type helper derived from priority_reasons array
normalized_fields.enabled_by: Duo Trust Monitor bypass-status enabling actor object
normalized_fields.enabled_for: Duo Trust Monitor bypass-status target user or group object
normalized_fields.bypass_status_enabled: Unix epoch millisecond timestamp when bypass status was enabled
normalized_fields.user_id: Duo user identifier from Admin API user/phone inventory records
normalized_fields.user_status: Duo user lifecycle status such as active, bypass, disabled, or locked out
normalized_fields.phone_id: Duo phone/device identifier from Admin API user phone inventory records
normalized_fields.phone_platform: Duo phone platform such as Apple iOS or Android
normalized_fields.phone_model: Duo phone model string from Admin API inventory
normalized_fields.phone_type: Duo phone type such as Mobile
normalized_fields.phone_last_seen: Last-seen timestamp for the Duo phone/device where present
normalized_fields.phone_encrypted: Duo phone encryption posture value where present
normalized_fields.phone_screenlock: Duo phone screen-lock posture value where present
normalized_fields.phone_tampered: Duo phone tamper posture value where present
normalized_fields.phone_capabilities: Duo phone authentication capabilities array where present
normalized_fields.integration_key: Duo integration/application identifier from Admin API integration inventory records
normalized_fields.integration_name: Duo integration/application display name from Admin API integration inventory records
normalized_fields.integration_type: Duo integration type such as saml, websdk, or adminapi
normalized_fields.adminapi_read_log: Admin API permission flag for reading log information on integration records
normalized_fields.adminapi_read_resource: Admin API permission flag for retrieving resource objects on integration records
normalized_fields.adminapi_integrations: Admin API permission flag for integration object administration
normalized_fields.adminapi_settings: Admin API permission flag for settings access
normalized_fields.adminapi_write_resource: Admin API permission flag for resource modification on integration records
normalized_fields.user_access: Duo integration user-access posture such as ALL_USERS, NO_USERS, or PERMITTED_GROUPS
normalized_fields.groups_allowed: Duo group IDs allowed to use the integration where present
normalized_fields.policy_key: Duo policy identifier attached to the integration where present
normalized_fields.prompt_v4_enabled: Duo Universal Prompt enabled flag for the integration where present
normalized_fields.frameless_auth_prompt_enabled: Duo frameless prompt support flag for the integration where present
normalized_fields.networks_for_api_access: Admin/API integration network access allowlist text where returned

test_event_sets.description: Synthetic-equivalent one-line Cisco Duo Admin API authentication, activity, telephony, Trust Monitor, and selected user/phone inventory JSON records, including Activity Logs v2 nested action/target shape, Telephony Logs v2 SMS/phone usage shape, Trust Monitor auth/bypass/device-registration security-event shapes, Admin API user phone inventory shape, and Admin API integration/application permission inventory shape.

timestamp_policy.notes: Fixtures use Duo isotimestamp or Activity Logs v2 / Telephony Logs v2 ts with explicit +00:00 offset; Trust Monitor fixtures preserve documented surfaced_timestamp epoch milliseconds and nested surfaced_auth.isotimestamp where present; user/phone inventory fixtures preserve documented phone last_seen without stating source-time parsing, with receiver-time fallback until collector timestamp handling is validated; integration inventory fixtures do not carry a source event time and rely on collector/receiver-time policy.

pack_variants.label: Cisco Duo Admin API JSON relay
pack_variants.description: One-line JSON records preserving Duo authentication, activity, selected telephony, selected Trust Monitor security-event, selected user/phone inventory structures, and selected integration/application permission inventory structures.
known_limitations: No live Duo relay replay/read-back captured.

Only selected authentication, v1 flat activity, one Activity Logs v2 WebAuthn credential shape, one Telephony Logs v2 SMS/phone usage shape, Trust Monitor auth/bypass/device-registration shapes, one user/phone inventory shape, and one integration inventory shape are synthetic-fixture-backed.

API pagination, collector envelope metadata, broader telephony, unsupported Trust Monitor event types, broader endpoint/integration inventory variants, and complete optional-field coverage need local capture before SecHub can state broader coverage safely.

cribl.notes: Use only after sampling local Duo exports. Do not drop identity, application, factor/result/reason, endpoint posture, timestamps, event identifiers, activity object, or raw JSON by default.

vector.notes: Vector support is recorded as a conservative sources/transforms/sinks mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Vector config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

fluent_bit.notes: Fluent Bit support is recorded as a conservative collector/pipeline mapping only: collector/API relay path; keep credential custody and checkpoints outside this pack and preserve source timestamps and raw payloads. No Fluent Bit config artifact is generated by this pack yet.

known_limitations: No live Duo Admin API/collector relay replay/read-back captured.
This pack does not implement API polling, pagination, SIEM connector custody, or credential handling.

Only selected authentication, v1 flat activity, one Activity Logs v2 WebAuthn credential shape, one Telephony Logs v2 SMS/phone usage shape, Trust Monitor auth/bypass/device-registration shapes, one user/phone inventory shape, and one integration inventory shape are synthetic-fixture-backed.
Broader telephony variants, unsupported Trust Monitor event types, broader endpoint/integration inventory variants, and complete optional-field coverage remain future variants.
Endpoint posture, Trust Monitor explanation arrays, and group fields may be sensitive; no reduction is enabled by default.
